text:
ashok (AE): Hey team — AegisBank sent the SIG and flagged Q3.2 (KMS key rotation), Q4.1 (access reviews) and wants sample artifacts. Need to stitch answers + attachments by EOD Friday. Who can own?

rachel (Sales Eng): I can own the assembly. Quick asks: do we have a canned artifact for key-rotation logs + policy? I can drop drive links and short answers.

maria (Security): I have a redacted key rotation policy and an audit log export example. Note: we should avoid publishing real key IDs — use masked values. Sample snippet I usually share: ```
KMS rotation interval: 90 days
Rotation owner: platform-security@redwood.com
Rotation verification: automated CI job -> monthly audit
```

ben (CS): Also the customer asked if they can test with a Dedicated POC environment. We should include the POC checklist and any temporary creds/process for onboarding. I can coordinate the access window once docs are ready.

rachel (Sales Eng): Perfect. I'll assemble a Q-by-Q doc. Links: internal playbook (https://redwood.company/playbooks/sig-responses) and a redacted artifact bundle location: `s3://redwood-evidence/aegisbank/sig/redacted/`

maria (Security): I'm uploading two files to that bucket now: `rotation_policy_v2.pdf` and `kms_audit_sample.log.gz`. The audit sample is a 30-day export with masked key IDs. Add this blurb for Q3.2: "Key management is handled via customer-managed KMS or Redwood-managed KMS with documented rotation and automated auditing. Rotation policy enforced every 90 days; audit logs retained 1 year."

ashok (AE): For Q4.1 (access reviews) what's the short answer? They want cadence + owner.

maria (Security): Add: "Access reviews are quarterly; owners are the app/product managers with Security notified. We use RBAC groups in Okta + monthly reconciliation script that outputs exceptions for manual review"

rachel (Sales Eng): Draft answers uploaded: `s3://redwood-evidence/aegisbank/sig/drafts/q_by_q.md` — Please review before I convert to their SIG XLS. I added 1-sentence canned answers and bullet points linking artifacts.

ben (CS): Tagging for POC: @rachel when ready, I need the exact time window to provision Dedicated POC (GPU config + VPC peering steps). Customer prefers next Tue.

rachel (Sales Eng): Will aim to finalize tomorrow noon. Ben — recommend provisioning slot Tue 9-11am PT.

ashok (AE): Thanks — do we need any legal redaction signoff? I want to avoid back-and-forth with procurement.

maria (Security): No legal required for these artifacts (policy + audit sample) — but we must ensure no customer-specific identifiers. I've redacted. If anyone adds screenshots, run them past me quickly.

sigbot: Reminder: SIG deadline for AegisBank in 48 hours. https://redwood.company/ops/sig-deadlines

rachel (Sales Eng): Final owner: me for the narrative + attachments. Maria will sign off on redaction + security language. Ben will own POC access. Ashok — can you confirm customer contact for delivery?

ashok (AE): Confirmed: marge.k@aegisbank.com. I'll set calendar invite after you post final XLS. Thanks all :thumbsup:

rachel (Sales Eng): Noted. I'll post the completed XLS and evidence zip to the bucket and ping here when done.

maria (Security): Quick QA: include this single-line proof for Q3.2 in the XLS: `Rotation enforcement: automated job (rotation-checker v1.3) -> logs at s3://redwood-evidence/audits/rotation-checks/`

rachel (Sales Eng): Got it. Will include and close loop.
